name: Web Recon — Git Repository Leak
description:
📖 Scenario

A developer accidentally deployed a repository directory to the production server.

The repository itself may not be immediately visible through normal browsing. Your task is to determine whether development artifacts have been exposed.

🎯 Mission

Investigate:

[clickThisLink](Flag1.cgcybercom.online/repo/)

Look for the Git repository metadata.

Submit only the required answer using the flag format: pcgCTF{answer}

hints.content: Git repositories contain a hidden directory used to store repository information.
If /repo/ doesn't show it, try requesting the hidden directory directly.
